node.title: Re: Combining Ffile:fetch with MySQL
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I guess alternatively, automatically renaming the saved file to uniquedata.pdf would work as well, but I wasn't able to figure out how to do that. Has anyone done something like this?

Since it sounds like the URLs are unique, you could use [Corion]'s [mod://Text::CleanFragment] on them to get filenames. For the rest, I think it would be better if you show some example code, see [id://1177642|SSCCE].
